description: The SPW project deposits a synthetic population for Manipur, India, with people assigned to households, residences and daily activity places. Zenodo marks it open under CC BY 4.0 and lists a data ZIP, README, contact-matrix CSV and graphics. The public README names five internal CSV categories and cites DHS households, GPW demographic counts, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived points of interest. A modeller could use the household and activity assignments as starting agents for a Manipur emergency-service reachability simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this regional deposit. A limitation is that the records are synthetic and generated for population interaction studies; they do not measure actual trips, shelter choices or road restrictions. The provider calls the series a coarse version, so local settlements and travel schedules may need independent adjustment. The archive was not downloaded and no simulated person or coordinate was inspected.
